in_sanskrit.name: परदम
in_sanskrit.meaning: पर (par) - above, over + दम (dam) - to subdue, tame
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who subdues above or beyond

in_hindi.meaning: पर (par) - above, over + दूम (dum) - sound, noise
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who produces a sound above or beyond

in_tamil.name: பரதும்
in_tamil.meaning: பர (par) - above, over + தும் (thum) - to exist, be
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who exists above or beyond

in_telugu.name: పరదుమ్
in_telugu.meaning: పర (par) - above, over + దుమ్ (dum) - to be, exist
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who exists above or beyond

in_marathi.name: Pardum
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pardum हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pardum is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Parvata' which means mountain. The name 'Pardum' signifies the lord or ruler of the mountains. In Hindu mythology, Parvati, the wife of Lord Shiva, is often depicted as residing in the mountains. Hence, Pardum is a strong and powerful name for a baby boy.

Hence, Pardum is a strong and powerful name for a baby boy.
